title: The Song Slowed Down for You
youtube_title: The Song Slowed Down for You | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude is a useful favor, not only a thank-you word.
summary: At a cottage kitchen on an ordinary kind morning, Brisa notices that Cousin Pio has already taken care of a song slowed down so you could catch the words. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Brisa does one useful thing Cousin Pio did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
